easy.def: A line that goes one way and then the other, again and again.
examples: I drew a zigzag on my paper.
The rabbit ran in a zigzag.
My sweater has a zigzag on it.

more.def: A line or path with sharp turns from side to side.
examples: The path went up the hill in a zigzag.
Lightning made a bright zigzag across the sky.
She cut a zigzag along the edge of the paper.

easy.def: A thing with tiny teeth that opens and closes a coat or bag.
examples: Zip up your zipper. It is cold!
The zipper on my bag is broken.

more.def: A fastener with two rows of small teeth that lock together when you slide a tab.
examples: The zipper on my backpack got stuck.
The tent door closes with a long zipper.
He pulled the zipper of his coat up to his chin.
